allowed_core_claims: On frozen CTP100, M3 achieves a stable STSR improvement over M2.
M3's main advantage should be attributed to state-driven adaptive multi-agent scheduling; result reuse mainly improves resource efficiency.
CTP30-v2 shows no M3-over-M2 advantage and should be discussed as an unseen sealed multiturn generalization boundary.
disallowed_claims: M3 outperforms M2 in all tourism scenarios.
Result reuse improves target-turn task success rate.
M3 is cheaper or more token-efficient than M2 in the main experiment.
The formal experiment uses real-time weather.
Standardized estimated cost equals the real relay API bill.
The dataset was independently annotated by multiple annotators.
manual_submission_todos: Fill author, affiliation, corresponding author, email, and funding information.
Apply the official Telecommunications Science journal template.
Convert the Markdown draft to Word or the required submission format.
Convert Markdown tables to journal-style three-line tables.
Draw system architecture and M3 adaptive scheduling flow figures.
Add Chinese references on smart tourism, tourism recommendation, LLM agents, tool use, and telecom-tourism applications.
Normalize all references to the journal style.
Tighten the two minor wording issues identified by paper_claim_audit_v1.
Run a final full-text claim and formatting check before submission.
final_recommendation: Do not run more experiments for the current paper version. Proceed with manual formatting, figures, references, and final claim/format checks.
